description: Exact-source automated incident control exercise for six required scenarios. It executes the repository validators and committed recovery evidence relevant to each scenario, then verifies severity, containment, stop conditions, evidence preservation, recovery verification and closure gating. This is not a human-led tabletop, configured paging exercise, production incident drill or independent review.

requiredContainment: stop affected write traffic
preserve request and database evidence without tenant identifiers
invalidate ambiguous sessions
block promotion until cross-tenant visibility is independently excluded
requiredStopConditions: verified principal or RLS authority cannot be proven

requiredContainment: fail Preview commit closed
preserve the independently verified sealed spool
do not rerun object fetch or parser when ResumeCommit evidence is available
keep promotion blocked until durable row accounting is verified
requiredStopConditions: deleted or expired authority could resurrect

requiredContainment: fail before parsing and database mutation
do not substitute an unverified object version
preserve checksum and source-version bindings
quarantine ambiguous object state instead of deleting it
requiredStopConditions: checksum or metadata binding is inconsistent
source and backup recovery points are incoherent

requiredContainment: stop destructive contract migration
preserve the old application rollback target
prefer application rollback or forward fix over automatic down migration
keep candidate baseline evidence separate from approved release compatibility
requiredStopConditions: schema fingerprint or migration sequence drift is detected

requiredContainment: keep restored environment isolated
block traffic promotion
preserve recovery point and verification evidence
treat deleted data or expired session resurrection as a security incident
requiredStopConditions: deleted account or session resolves after restore
database and object recovery points are incoherent
RPO or RTO is unapproved or unmeasured

requiredContainment: kill the parser process group
remove partial spool attempts
preserve sealed evidence only after independent verification
keep database and credentials outside the worker boundary
requiredStopConditions: partial output or spool residue remains

limitations: no paging or acknowledgement path was exercised
no external legal, privacy or user communication contact tree was exercised
no production traffic or production credentials were used
no destructive recovery or traffic promotion occurred
not a completed tabletop or production recovery drill
